title: Alexa and Matter: where the code comes from
description: Echo devices are Matter controllers and have no code to scan. Alexa takes the accessory's QR or 11 digit code, shares devices with a 15 minute code under Other Assistants and Apps, and needs a Thread enabled Echo for Thread devices.
lede: An Echo has no Matter code of its own. The code is on the accessory, and Alexa has its own place to type it and its own way to share a device onward.

rows.text: Amazon: the pairing code is found on the device instructions or on the device itself. Install Matter devices within 30 feet of a compatible Alexa hub or device.
Devices, the plus, Add Device, the Matter icon, Yes, then Try Numeric Code Instead, and enter the 11 digit code.

Devices, the device, Other Assistants and Apps, Add another. Copy the 11 digit pairing code that is generated; it is only valid for 15 minutes. Amazon confirms the printed code is only for initial setup or after a factory reset.
Need a Thread enabled Echo. Without one, Amazon's advice is to set the device up with another Thread enabled assistant first and share it to Alexa.
